class.name: JRPGChoiceWindow
class.brief_description: The choice window: the choices beside the message window, the default one selected, cancel refused, a choice or a branch.
class.description: Shows choices as Show Choices does: a [JRPGSelectableList] as wide as the widest choice, beside the message window named by [member message_window] (above a message in the lower part of the screen, below one at the top; at the bottom of the screen without a message), at the left, middle or right. Choices may hold control codes for colors, icons and sizes; the window is as wide as the widest choice as drawn, and stays on the screen. Blank choices are not shown (see [method is_blank_choice]), and [signal choice_made] reports the index a choice had among those given. The cursor starts on the default choice. Cancel is refused ([constant CANCEL_DISALLOWED]), picks a choice, or is a branch of its own ([constant CANCEL_BRANCH]). After a choice the window lets go of the focus and cannot take it again (not even by a click) until [method show_choices], so a second press chooses nothing. Authority: client. Online, the server checks the index it receives.

method.name: get_cancel_choice
method.description: Returns what cancel does: [constant CANCEL_DISALLOWED], [constant CANCEL_BRANCH] or the index of the choice it picks.

method.name: get_placement
method.description: Returns where the window was placed by the last [method show_choices].

method.name: is_blank_choice
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param choice] is left out: nothing but blanks and control codes that show nothing. A choice with an icon ([code]\I[n][/code]) is shown.

method.name: show_choices
method.description: Shows [param choices] with the cursor on [param default] (an index among the choices given). [param cancel] is [constant CANCEL_DISALLOWED], [constant CANCEL_BRANCH] or the index of the choice cancel picks. A [param cancel] that is none of these is an error, and cancel is refused. [param placement] puts the window at the left, middle or right; [param background] is the window frame, a dimmed band ([member JRPGWindow.dim_visible]) or none. Opens the window and gives it the focus. When every choice is blank, nothing is shown (an error) and [signal choice_made] reports the choice cancel picks, or [constant CANCEL_BRANCH] when cancel is refused, on the next idle frame, so the game never waits for a choice that cannot be made.

members.member: The message window the choices go beside. Empty: the bottom of the screen.

signal.name: choice_made
signal.description: Emitted when the player chooses: [param index] is the choice's index among those given, or [constant CANCEL_BRANCH] when cancel is a branch of its own.
